about_the_game:
A world of fun competitions, cute animals, and dozens of exciting mini-games awaits you. Gather your friends or family and test yourself in a wide variety of challenges where anyone can win!

20+ mini-games

The game will feature at least 20 unique levels, each with its own setting, rules, and dynamics. Regular updates will add new mini-games to keep players coming back for more.

Cute animals and character customization

Players will be able to choose a character from a gallery of adorable animals: foxes, rabbits, raccoons, cats, and others.

Before the game, you can choose your favorite shoes, and select accessories such as hats, glasses, headphones, and more. You can also choose the colors of our clothes.

Customization options will be unlocked separately for each character as they gain experience points.

Fun for friends and the whole family

A minimum of cruelty and aggression — only benevolent humor, competition and positive emotions. Suitable for playing with children, parents or friends. The mini-games are designed to give the joy of participation, even if the player does not take first place.

Local and online multiplayer

All games are optimized for convenient play on a single screen. 

In the future, we plan to add the ability to play with friends online.

Everyone has a chance to win

Each mini-game tests different skills:

  • Speed — who reacts faster.

  • Dexterity — the ability to control your character accurately.

  • Memory — remembering sequences and details.

  • Wit — solving puzzles.

  • Luck — random game events that give even beginners a chance.

This allows every player to prove themselves.

name: Fluffy Rumble

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Intel Core i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MD Radeon RX 560 or NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Fluffy Rumble is a fun collection of sports and adventure mini-games for friends and family! Compete in basketball, snowboard races, coconut tosses, explore mazes, and complete dozens of other challenges with cute fluffy characters.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
